correction_note: Corrected the repeated-key record share metric. Initial report incorrectly labeled unique-key share (51.51%) as duplicate share. Corrected metrics: extra-records-beyond-first share = 48.49% (2386/4921); records-in-multi-groups share = 63.67% (3133/4921). Also adds near-duplicate bbox pairs (13).

metrics.unique_candidate_ids: N/A — candidate_id field absent from record schema; each record identified by position (paper_id + index)

key_definitions.unique_candidate_ids: N/A — candidate_id field absent; each record uniquely positioned by (paper_id, index).
key_definitions.unique_source_occurrences: A unique (paper_id, page_number, bbox_x, bbox_y, bbox_w, bbox_h) tuple. Verified: 4,921 of 4,921 records have unique bboxes — no two records occupy identical spatial coordinates.
key_definitions.repeated_normalized_text: Duplicate (paper_id, page_number, normalized_line_text) where normalization collapses whitespace and lowercases. 747 keys have >1 record (multi-groups); 1,788 keys have exactly 1 record (single-groups).
key_definitions.extra_occurrences: Number of records beyond the first occurrence of each unique key: total - unique_line_keys = 4,921 - 2,535 = 2,386. These are copies of equations that were extracted more than once.
key_definitions.records_with_repeated_key: All records in multi-record groups: 3,133 records (63.67%). Includes first + extra occurrences.
key_definitions.exact_duplicate_records: Records with identical paper_id, page, line_text, classification, and char_count: 3,128 (63.57%). Subset of records_with_repeated_key.
key_definitions.overlapping_bbox: Near-duplicate bboxes: 13 pairs detected with >50% area overlap on the same page. These are spatially co-located equations — a stronger signal of duplicate occurrence than normalized text alone.
key_definitions.share_interpretation: Unique-key share = 51.51% (2,535 lines referenced within each key once). Extra-occurrence share = 48.49% (2,386 records are copied duplicates). Records-with-repeated-key share = 63.67% (3,133 records share a key with another record). All three are distinct; report all three.

methodology.unique_source_definition: Spatial occurrence key = f'{paper_id}|{page_number}|{x0:.6f}|{y0:.6f}|{x1:.6f}|{y1:.6f}'. Coordinates at 6-decimal precision, making spatial collision effectively impossible.
methodology.text_occurrence_definition: Text occurrence key = f'{paper_id}|{page_number}|{normalized_line_text}'. Normalization: lowercase, whitespace-collapse.
methodology.exact_definition: Exact duplicate = identical (paper_id, page, line_text, classification, char_count).
methodology.spatial_definition: Two bboxes on the same page are near-duplicates if their intersection area > 50% of min(area_a, area_b).
methodology.three_share_metrics: Three distinct metrics: (a) unique_key_share = unique_line_keys/total; (b) extra_occurrence_share = (total-unique_line_keys)/total; (c) records_with_repeated_key_share = records_in_multi/total. Do not conflate.
